question: What is the name of the mascot of the third edition of Khelo India University Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jitu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The mascot of the third edition of Khelo India University Games is **Jitu**.
 
• The 3rd Khelo India University Games (KIUG) were held in Uttar Pradesh in 2023.
 
• Khelo India University Games is an initiative by the Government of India to promote sports and fitness among the youth.
 
• The mascot plays a significant role in engaging and inspiring participants and the audience.
 
• The previous editions of the Khelo India University Games have been successful in identifying and nurturing young sporting talent across the country.
 
• The event includes various sports disciplines and is aimed at fostering a competitive spirit and unity among university students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Khelo India initiative was launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in 2018.
 
• The program aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports played in our country and establishing India as a great sporting nation.
 
• Under this program, talented players identified in priority sports disciplines at various levels are provided annual financial assistance of INR 5 lakhs per annum for 8 years.
 
• The initiative also includes the Khelo India Youth Games and Khelo India Winter Games, among others.
 
• The introduction of mascots in sports events helps in creating a unique identity and excitement around the games.
